_comment: The images a release publishes to Docker Hub (nextgcore #420). release.yml builds each
binary with its cargo_args in a Debian bookworm toolchain (the images' runtime base, and
the build nextgcore's E2E validates), then pushes <namespace>/<image>:<version> and :latest.
ci.yml's release-images job (docker/check-release-images.sh) fails when a [[bin]] target,
a Dockerfile, or an image a compose file or k8s manifest references is neither here nor in
`excluded`. local_names are the names compose, k8s and nextgcore's CI use for the image.
extra_binaries are built too and land in binaries/ beside the image's own binary.

extra_binaries.why: Dockerfile.ue-local COPYs it when present; nr-ue-deregister needs it (#365)

excluded.reason: Open5GS interop exit-gate harness: a hand-built kernel-SCTP gNB on Debian trixie, run locally against openverso/open5gs; not a release image
Open5GS interop exit-gate harness UE (see Dockerfile.gnb-kernel); not a release image
load-test command-line tool; no image is defined for it
